title: Space bound from an interval of visited positions
statement: Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine, $d$ a configuration, $t\in\mathbb{N}$, $i$ a work-tape index, and $lo,hi\in\mathbb{Z}$. Suppose that for every $u\in\mathbb{N}$ with $u\le t$, the head position of tape $i$ after $u$ steps lies in the integer interval $[lo,hi]$. Then the space used by tape $i$ through step $t$ is at most $(hi+1-lo).toNat$, the natural-number conversion of the integer $hi+1-lo$.
hypotheses_covered: for every $u\le t$, the head position of tape $i$ after $u$ steps belongs to $[lo,hi]$
